# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VWAP_REJECTION_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY gaps up ≥0.4% at open but fails to reclaim VWAP within the first 20 minutes, the gap often fades, providing a short opportunity. This edge exists because initial gap-up momentum frequently lacks follow-through buying pressure, allowing mean reversion toward VWAP and gap fill.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If:** prior day’s close * 1.004 (gap ≥0.4%) AND close of the 4th 5‑min bar after open (20‑min mark) is below VWAP → enter short at next bar’s open.  
**Exit:** Chart‑stop at gap’s high (high of first 5‑min bar) OR premium‑stop of 0.6%; TP1 at 1.2R (target gap fill); runner trail 8% off HWM.  
**Regime Filters:** VIX <18, no strong pre‑market news, avoid first 10‑min volume >2× average.
